Subject: Intro + scheduling request: Priya Shah (SWE)

Hi Lauren / Karthik / Marissa,

Quick intro — Priya Shah applied to the SWE role; strong backend + infra experience, coming out of a take-home and a short phone screen. Resume attached (PriyaShah_Resume.pdf). Hiring manager is excited and asking for a virtual full loop.

We'd like to schedule a sequential half-day with three focused slots (systems design, coding pair, culture/product) rather than parallel panels to reduce cognitive switching for the candidate. Candidate is on PST and prefers morning windows. We also want to run the debrief async for folks who will be evaluating in different timezones — can we agree on owners for the async notes?

Proposed dates/times (PDT):
- Option A: Tue 2026-06-22 09:00–12:30 (three slots with 20m buffers)
- Option B: Wed 2026-06-23 09:30–13:00
- Option C: Thu 2026-06-24 08:30–12:00

Suggested sequencing: Systems (50m) -> Coding (60m) -> Product/Culture (45m) with 20m breaks. Recruiter will send candidate logistics. Can Lauren confirm recommended sequencing + debrief owners, and Marissa can you lock in a provisional scribe / evaluation template?

Attachments: PriyaShah_Resume.pdf

Thanks,
Sam Ortiz
Senior Recruiter, RecruiterCo

Thanks Sam — looks good. Quick notes:

1) Sequencing: agree with sequential slots. My preference is: Systems design (50m) -> 15m break -> Coding pair (60m) -> 20m break -> Product/Culture (45m). The extra break before coding helps the candidate reset.

2) Panel ordering rationale: Systems first to surface system-level trade-offs, coding when candidate is warmed up but not exhausted, product/culture last for fit.

3) Debrief plan: Asynchronous debrief to be posted in the shared doc. Marissa — can you own the tech debrief (systems + coding consolidated) and fill the evaluation_template.docx? Grace — can you own culture notes and synthesize the short summary for hiring manager? I'll own aggregate hiring recommendation and sign-off.

4) Buffers & scoring: keep 20m between coding and product, 15m between systems and coding. Use the attached evaluation template for consistent prompts.

I'll pencil Option A (Tue 6/22) tentatively and send calendar blocks once we confirm evaluator availability.

Lauren Bishop
Staff Recruiter (Hiring Ops)
